card.name: Allergy wording before an allergen is named
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, including, of, with, and contains right where a drug label is about to name something a patient may be allergic to. Typical settings are contraindications and hypersensitivity statements.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to a named product
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'including' after 'hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis,' where the allergen comes next.

modes.description: Linking words before an ingredient that can cause allergy, such as milk proteins or a sulfite.

card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a label names what someone may be allergic to, such as egg or milk.
